The panel will sit at the top of the workspace. A full-width toggle bar will serve as the collapsed state. When expanded, it will slide down as a full-screen overlay containing the settings and a close button.

The toggle itself is the collapsed state. The expansion will animate downward from the top bar to fill the screen. Considering transform, max-height, or clip-path for the transition. Fixed positioning with animation, similar to existing expandOverlay patterns, seems most appropriate.

The toggle will be a full-width bar fixed at the top of the workspace. The overlay will use fixed positioning and slide down from the top edge. State will be `knobsOpen` defaulting to false. The toggle bar will sit at the very top of the workspace, before the panels grid. The overlay will use fixed inset 0 to fill the screen. The panel will start collapsed at the top edge and expand downward into full-screen settings. The expanded panel will be a full-screen overlay with a header and close button. The slide-down animation will originate from the toggle position. The implementation steps are adding the `knobsOpen` state, moving the controls to the top of the workspace, writing CSS for the toggle bar and animated panel, and replacing the inline controls div.

The panel will animate downward via translateY or scaleY from the top edge. The toggle will include aria-expanded. The controls block will sit immediately after the workspace section opens, before the panels grid. The panel will remain permanently visible rather than being restricted to the explore stage.

The overlay will use a dark blurred background with a fade-in animation. The panel will slide down from the top edge over 420 milliseconds using a smooth cubic-bezier curve. It will scroll internally and match the existing surface styling.

Closing will be instant rather than animated. The header will include a close button, and clicking the backdrop will also dismiss the panel. The existing `.controls` class will lose its max-width constraint to accommodate the full-screen layout. The knobs content may be extracted into a variable to keep the diff minimal.
